scope: Candidate source-derived joint centers; diagnostic until sweep and owner articulation review. Fits use geometry of this exact Kestrel source, never Warden thresholds.

rightKnee.fitMethod: Least-squares YZ circle centers on the matching outer/inner round cap pieces; X is component mean. Midpoint defines joint center.
rightKnee.note: Axle is tilted slightly in source. Axis may be normalized in repaired adapter after neutral-placement validation.

leftKnee.fitMethod: Least-squares YZ circle centers on the matching outer/inner round cap pieces; X is component mean. Midpoint defines joint center.
leftKnee.note: Axle is tilted slightly in source. Axis may be normalized in repaired adapter after neutral-placement validation.

rightAnkle.fitMethod: Midpoint of large fore-ankle casing bounds. Inner casing is flared and fails a reliable single-circle fit; bounded estimate is preferable to biased fit.
rightAnkle.note: Do not use the smaller rear talon axle cap pair: right 9/49, left 115/126; those stay with foot.

leftAnkle.fitMethod: Midpoint of large fore-ankle casing bounds. Inner casing is flared and fails a reliable single-circle fit; bounded estimate is preferable to biased fit.
leftAnkle.note: Do not use the smaller rear talon axle cap pair: right 9/49, left 115/126; those stay with foot.

rightHip.note: YZ from actual round inner bearing 39; X is midpoint of bearing 39 / thigh-shell 7 overlap. Axis [1,0,0] is a near-X orientation estimate, not an exact fitted physical axle; validate in neutral and sweep.

leftHip.note: YZ from actual round inner bearing 139; X is midpoint of bearing 139 / thigh-shell 121 overlap. Axis [1,0,0] is a near-X orientation estimate, not an exact fitted physical axle; validate in neutral and sweep.

waist.note: Open cage and its cap rings account for 1,292 imported triangles; replace within this envelope using geometry matching the approved closed ribbed bearing.

postSplitOwnership.notes: Keep complete knee caps/casings shin-owned. Main shell split runs through concealed joint interior; cap its cut boundaries explicitly. Upper hydraulic and shin piston endpoint continuity still requires a sweep; rigid grouping alone is not proof.
